name: boardrepo
description: A workspace for PCB projects. Explore public boards and inspect schematics, layouts, BOMs, files and saved versions with your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription:
BoardRepo is a workspace for PCB projects. Keep your KiCad designs and saved versions together, explore public boards, and bring real design context into your AI tools.

Connect your AI assistant to find public PCB projects and inspect schematics, layouts, bills of materials and source files. Compare saved versions and read existing DRC/ERC reports, with citations and clear coverage limits.
defaultPrompt: Find a published nRF54L15 board and explain its power circuit from the schematic.
Check whether this BoardRepo board passes KiCad DRC/ERC and a compatible fab profile.
Review my BoardRepo board, verify each finding, and report what was not checked.
